description: New Zealand v0 held-out references: Accommodation Supplement comparators (recipients, MSD Accommodation Assistance expenditure, Treasury AN 24/01) and the Working for Families tripwire. MC5 holds these out of calibration; no calibration-side graph node may read this resource. target_role is validation throughout. Every row is an unactivated placeholder. Each period follows the label convention of its Chronicle package (IRD tax years by closing year; MSD fiscal years by opening year, as recorded in source_period_kind, source_period_start and source_period_end); activation re-checks every period against the harvested facts.

target_references.name: msd_accommodation_supplement_recipients_by_region
target_references.notes: Held out (MC5, conflict C5): calibrating to Accommodation Supplement recipients would predetermine the take-up comparison. MSD Work and Income regions are not Stats NZ regions, so comparison needs an explicit geography bridge. Compared with modelled eligible units, never used as a target.

target_references.name: msd_annual_report_accommodation_assistance_expenditure
target_references.notes: MSD Annual Report 2025, Benefits or Related Expenses, 2024/25 actual, published line "Accommodation Assistance" (targets doc M2). The comparator for the annual dollar gap (MC2). The line label may cover more than the Accommodation Supplement; the Chronicle package must record the appropriation definition before any statement that calls it Accommodation Supplement paid. Period 2024 is the opening year of the July-June fiscal year.

target_references.name: treasury_an24_01_accommodation_supplement_fiscal_total
target_references.notes: Treasury Analytical Note AN 24/01 fiscal_totals.csv, Accommodation Supplement row, tax year 2018/19 (targets doc T4, CC0). A secondary historical comparator only; it is never scaled or uprated to the model year.

target_references.name: ird_wff_recipient_families
target_references.notes: Held out as the Working for Families tripwire (IRD WFF statistics, targets doc I3). Cell-pinned IRD administrative count of families with a claim and non-zero final entitlement, not every eligible family and not cash paid. Chronicle owns the September 2025 workbook facts. Activation requires a separate family receipt/claim state and an explicit bridge from tax year ending 2024 to the 2026-27 build basis. Total and average entitlement NZD remain held-out validation, never calibration values. No v0 graph node computes WFF, so the comparison is parked until the WFF modules are bound.

target_references.name: ird_wff_recipient_families_by_family_income_band
target_references.notes: IRD WFF recipient-family income distribution (targets doc I3, 2020 onward): the one published conditional slice of the joint-income distribution, reported as the joint-income tripwire. Held out; never calibration.
